div.div: why not release_ref_token() on exit of talking? because not all actions lead to it.
why not make the data delivery a reaction to noevent and then add release_ref_token() as exit of talking?

because then the reaction would need a guard and the ability to return a next state, which it can do neither. and we would defeat the whole purpose of a reaction (not transitioning) if we implement this ability.
